caption: Molecular airglow and auroral band systems (171 rows). Heads and origins are different features: a head is the turning point of one branch, the origin ν₀ = T(v′) − T(v″) lies between branches and coincides with no line. N₂ and N₂⁺: Lofthus & Krupenie 1977; O₂: Krupenie 1972 (both read from the table images of the JPCRD reprints); NO: nominal positions from Meier 1991; OH Meinel origins derived here from HITRAN2020 level energies; continua after Noll et al. 2025. “Origin λ₀” is derived from the tabulated wavenumber. Line-resolved OH and O₂ positions are in §5.3–5.4.

cols.label: λ (Å)

cols.label: Feature

cols.label: Precision (Å)

cols.label: Origin λ₀ (Å)
